messages:
Alice: Quick sync — final pass on marketplace launch readiness. Need signoff on press embargo window + confirm SI tenant provisioning. Timeline below, can folks confirm?

Ben: I can own the PR timeline. Proposed: embargo lift Tue 10am PT, blog Wed, landing page live Wed 8am PT. Is that too tight?

Clara: Tue 10am PT works for press. Need final hero image + feature bullets by EOD Monday. Who is owning hero?

Alice: Creative is on Joanna, cc @joanna.design (she's OOO today) — can we get a backup? Ben, can you confirm legal copy for embargo?

Dan: I'll review embargo language. Need partner logos + trademark approvals by Monday noon. Also flagging: any partners that require embargo exceptions? Please surface now.

Evan: SI side — we need test tenants and a canned quickstart. Can you add a 'SI partner sandbox' provision to the checklist? We can provision tenants by Monday but need creds + sample data schema.

Ben: Adding sandbox to the rollout checklist. Draft checklist I'll paste here and convert to a shared doc: 
```
- Partner logos collected and approved
- Hero asset (primary + backup)
- Embargo copy approved by Legal
- Press list + embargo notices scheduled
- SI sandbox credentials provisioned
- Landing page content + QA complete
- Partner quotes gathered
```
I'll create the doc and share a link in 30m.

deploy-bot: FYI — staging cutover scheduled Mon 02:00 PT. Any last-minute add-ons must be in by Sun 23:59 PT.

Clara: Also need partner quotes from HW partners — 1-2 lines per partner by Mon AM to populate the landing. @Alice can you nudge the HW team?

Alice: Nudge sent to HW contacts. @Evan can you coordinate an SI quote too? Even a short line about integration speed will do.

Evan: On it — will get 2 short lines from our SI lead by Mon 10am.

Dan: Quick legal question — catalog listing requires a DPA for EU customers. Are we providing a template or asking partners to supply?

Ben: Redwood will provide a DPA template. I'll attach it to the shared checklist doc.

Alice: Great. Action items recap: Ben -> finalize doc & checklist, Clara -> press list + hero backup, Dan -> finalize embargo/legal copy, Evan -> SI sandbox + quote, Ops -> staging creds. We meet Mon 09:30 PT for final go/no-go. :rocket:

Clara: Marked — I'll draft the partner embargo note and circulate for approvals.

Ben: Shared doc link: https://docs.redwood.example/s/marketplace-launch-checklist (draft) — please add comments inline.

Alice: Thanks everyone — closing thread for now. Ping me directly for any blockers. :thumbsup:
